entries.name: Country Chase
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 2:30. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. Use the ramp after the first turn; after rejoining, keep near the wall to avoid the paired tornadoes.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Hi-Potion first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Disney Drive
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:00. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. Take the town ramp and dash ring. At the narrow tornado path keep right or use a shield; turn sharply after the next shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Fire Dash first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Grand Spree
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:00. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. This reverses most of Disney Drive. Use town ramps to reach the shield ledge; watch the tornado after the dirt-road shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Aerora first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Castle Circuit
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:30. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. In the courtyard turn left and jump into the fenced hole for the short route. Underground, the right ledge is safer; a sharp left offers the riskier shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: First finish: Victory Line first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Fruitball — Bruisers
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds. Their defense is weak; exploit openings after their curved shots.
entries.reward: First win: Balloon Letter; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Fruitball — Chip & Dale
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds. Prepare for their bump and fast-shot combinations.
entries.reward: First win: Magnera; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Fruitball — Pete
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds. Avoid his shots because hits stun. Terra faces Captain Dark; Ventus/Aqua face Captain Justice.
entries.reward: First win: Chaos Snake; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Country Chase
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 2:30. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. Use the ramp after the first turn; after rejoining, keep near the wall to avoid the paired tornadoes.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Hi-Potion first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Disney Drive
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:00. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. Take the town ramp and dash ring. At the narrow tornado path keep right or use a shield; turn sharply after the next shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Fire Dash first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Grand Spree
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:00. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. This reverses most of Disney Drive. Use town ramps to reach the shield ledge; watch the tornado after the dirt-road shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Aerora first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Castle Circuit
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:30. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. In the courtyard turn left and jump into the fenced hole for the short route. Underground, the right ledge is safer; a sharp left offers the riskier shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: First finish: Victory Line first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Fruitball — Bruisers
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds. Their defense is weak; exploit openings after their curved shots.
entries.reward: First win: Balloon Letter; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Fruitball — Chip & Dale
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds. Prepare for their bump and fast-shot combinations.
entries.reward: First win: Magnera; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Fruitball — Pete
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. entries.reward: First win: Chaos Snake; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Country Chase
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 2:30. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. Use the ramp after the first turn; after rejoining, keep near the wall to avoid the paired tornadoes.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Hi-Potion first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Disney Drive
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:00. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. Take the town ramp and dash ring. At the narrow tornado path keep right or use a shield; turn sharply after the next shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Fire Dash first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Grand Spree
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:00. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. This reverses most of Disney Drive. Use town ramps to reach the shield ledge; watch the tornado after the dirt-road shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: Top three finish: Aerora first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Castle Circuit
entries.instructions: Arena five-lap time target: 5:30. Race victory and Arena timing are separate requirements. Accelerate through dash rings; brake for corners. Guard when DANGER warns of an attack. Shields permit passage through tornadoes; unshielded contact loses time. In the courtyard turn left and jump into the fenced hole for the short route. Underground, the right ledge is safer; a sharp left offers the riskier shortcut.
entries.prerequisites: Grand Spree: top three in Country Chase and Disney Drive. Castle Circuit: win Grand Spree.
entries.reward: First finish: Victory Line first time; Hi-Potion subsequently.

entries.name: Fruitball — Bruisers
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. Split grapes create five scoring balls; banana peels stun, and pineapples ricochet. Avoid leaving fruit unattended for five seconds. Their defense is weak; exploit openings after their curved shots.
entries.reward: First win: Balloon Letter; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.reward: First win: Magnera; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Fruitball — Pete
entries.instructions: Score more goals in three minutes; ties enter sudden death. Bump fruit upward, then use the prompted smash. entries.reward: First win: Chaos Snake; repeat: Balloon Letter.

entries.name: Terra
entries.instructions: Clear the Land of Departure. Defeat enemies while linked and collect that link’s emblem. The first and second emblems raise the link to levels 1 and 2, expanding its deck and granting the listed abilities; level 2 unlocks an enhanced finisher. Later emblems refill the gauge. Published decks and emblem probabilities are indexed except Pete’s unknown probabilities. First emblem: Overdrive. Second emblem: Auto-Block. Landbreaker: Guide the flaming ground marker with the movement stick to aim six successive stone eruptions. Activate only with a full D-Link gauge; activation restores HP. The linked deck temporarily replaces the equipped deck. Revert, leaving the room or opening the menu ends the link. Additional emblems at level 2 refill the gauge. D-Links cannot be activated with temporary allies or in Terra’s Eraqus/Terra-Xehanort battles. Linked decks by 0/1/2 emblems: Quick Blitz, Sliding Dash, Stun Edge / Quick Blitz, Sliding Dash, Stun Edge, Sliding Dash, Zero Gravity / Quick Blitz, Sonic Blade, Stun Edge, Sonic Blade, Zero Gravira, Binding Strike, Cure. Finishers by 0/1/2 emblems: Finish / Finish / Finish, Landbreaker. Emblem drop chances by current 0/1/2 emblems: 10% / 7% / 5%. Attack gauge multiplier: x0.4. Gauge bonus: Blow an enemy away +20% (Base) | +10% (Enhanced).

Defeat enemies while linked and collect that link’s emblem. The first and second emblems raise the link to levels 1 and 2, expanding its deck and granting the listed abilities; level 2 unlocks an enhanced finisher. Later emblems refill the gauge. Published decks and emblem probabilities are indexed except Pete’s unknown probabilities. First emblem: Munny Plus. Second emblem: Steal. Fruit Shot: After jumping, press the displayed command button to launch the pineapple (Triangle in the PlayStation layout). Rumble Rave: Drive the spinning kart into enemies. Exact inputs, hit count, power, and timing remain undocumented on the source page. Activate only with a full D-Link gauge; activation restores HP. The linked deck temporarily replaces the equipped deck. Revert, leaving the room or opening the menu ends the link. Additional emblems at level 2 refill the gauge. D-Links cannot be activated with temporary allies or in Terra’s Eraqus/Terra-Xehanort battles. Linked decks by 0/1/2 emblems: Victory Pose, Binding Strike, Confusion Strike / Victory Pose, Binding Strike, Confusion Strike, Confetti, Aerial Slam / Victory Pose, Binding Strike, Confusion Strike, Confetti, Binding Strike, Confusion Strike, Aerial Slam. Finishers by 0/1/2 emblems: Fruit Shot / Fruit Shot / Fruit Shot, Rumble Rave. Emblem drop chances by current 0/1/2 emblems: unknown / unknown / unknown. Attack gauge multiplier: ?. Gauge bonus: Collecting a prize +?.

entries.name: Vanitas Remnant
entries.prerequisites: Clear Final Episode, then examine the emblem in Badlands on a main-character save.
entries.instructions: D-Links are unavailable. Cure-family magic causes the boss to heal; use healing items or healing finish/defense abilities instead. Mines can punish close approaches; Ventus can use Tornado and Aqua Seeker Mine. Evade during the boss’s protected attacks. Retry does not necessarily restore spent items; the source distinguishes Retry from Continue.
entries.uncertainty: Sourced encounter overview; complete per-character attack/stat/recovery coverage remains unverified.

entries.name: Unknown
entries.prerequisites: Defeat Vanitas Remnant; return on a main save with Land of Departure accessible.
entries.instructions: Use short Thunder Surge openings and retreat before healing. Treasure Magnet helps recover scattered deck commands. Renewal Barrier punishes prolonged attacks; clones disappear when struck. In Final Mix, Air Slide can escape Collision Magnet before its follow-up. D-Link use can trigger early invisibility. Leave and return to repeat the fight.

entries.name: No Heart
entries.instructions: Attack the floating No Name Keyblade to remove the opening barrier, then fight No Heart directly. Keep healing windows between attacks; its large area attack can drain HP, commands and Focus. HD Shotlocks can damage No Heart; do not import PSP immunity assumptions.

entries.name: Monstro
entries.instructions: Defeat stomach Unversed to reach the exterior. The exterior normally has a three-minute limit; timeout returns you to the stomach with less safe floor, while the fourth exterior round has no timer. Hit the idling whale with two explosive barrels to stun it, then attack its tongue or use a Shotlock. HD HP is 1,500 rather than PSP 1,800.

entries.name: Dark Hide
entries.prerequisites: Reach the end of the separate Secret Episode.
entries.instructions: This boss is a Heartless. Barrier and Counter Blast answer the opening charging attacks; watch for teleports behind Aqua. Ignite and ranged attacks can create damage opportunities. Later afterimages make direction harder to read; heal between attack sequences.
